design_philosophy: Authoritative, data-rich, and high-impact. The UI must feel like a precision tool for career intelligence. We prioritize structure over decoration. Color is functional only—used strictly to guide action, highlight ATS scores, and indicate warnings. The background is a stark off-white, surfaces are pure white, and borders are explicitly defined to expose the structural grid.

scale.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-tight
scale.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight leading-tight

rules: Headings strictly use Cabinet Grotesk with negative tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter).
Do NOT use Inter or Roboto for any text elements.
Labels and overlines must use tracking-[0.2em] uppercase styling.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for all body text.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Grid Borders ('The Technical Look'). Dashboards should feel like a 'Control Room' with dense data, while the Landing Page uses the 'Tetris' bento layout for high asymmetry.
rules: Inner paddings for cards must be generous (p-6 or p-8).
Mobile images and major elements capped at max-h-[80vh].

buttons.primary: bg-[#0055FF] text-white hover:bg-[#0044CC] rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-[#0A192F] text-white hover:bg-black rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-colors
buttons.outline: border border-[#0A192F] text-[#0A192F] hover:bg-[#F3F4F6] rounded-none px-6 py-3 font-semibold transition-colors

data_visualization.styles: Use sharp lines, solid fills, and strict adherence to the brand accent colors (Green/Yellow/Red for ATS scores). Do NOT use soft gradients in charts.

icons.sizing: w-5 h-5 for inline, w-8 h-8 for featured blocks

shadcn_overrides: Override all default Shadcn radiuses to rounded-none or rounded-sm.
Override the Vercel-like soft shadows to crisp 1px borders + slight shadow-sm.
Tablists must have h-auto to prevent clipping.

hero_backgrounds.description: Modern urban glass office building reflecting sunset. Use in Landing Page hero with an overlay.
hero_backgrounds.overlay: bg-black/40 (if white text) or bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-md (if dark text)

abstract_tech.description: Abstract green light trails. Good for background in the 'Resume Scan Processing' screen or AI Optimization features.
Digital spheres interconnected. Good for 'Job Match calculation' loading state.

company_logos.description: Tech company logo placeholder (Grayscale filter recommended)

rules: NEVER use external placeholders like via.placeholder.com.
Images inside feature grids should be purely functional or highly stylized macro shots.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements MUST specify hover:bg and hover:text explicitly.

animations.entrance: Staggered fade-in-up (translate-y-4 opacity-0 to opacity-100) for lists and dashboard cards.
animations.progress_rings: Stroke-dashoffset transition from 0 to actual score for dramatic effect.

testing_requirements.data_testid: MANDATORY on all buttons, links, form inputs, score elements, and interactive modals.

page_specific_instructions.landing_page: Use high-contrast sections. A stark white hero, followed by a dark obsidian (#0A192F) feature section, reverting to white for pricing. Use large typography.
page_specific_instructions.dashboard: Keep strictly light theme with `#FAFAFA` background. Data density is king. Use 1px borders between widgets.
page_specific_instructions.results_page: The ATS score circular chart is the centerpiece. Surround it with bento-style cards detailing Missing Keywords, Heatmap sections, and Interview Probability.
page_specific_instructions.career_insights: Salary ranges must be explicitly formatted in ₹ (INR). Use clear bar charts or horizontal progress bars to indicate where the user falls on the salary bell curve.
